title: Message_CompositeAlerts::AddAlert live callback iteration

cases.case: SupportsMerge appends a same-type nonmerging candidate before cursor creation
cases.native_observation: The live traversal visits support-target; incoming merges and is not appended. List size 2; custom DynamicType calls 2.
cases.rust_observation: Matches native callback order, merge result, list size, and custom DynamicType call count.

cases.case: Merge appends a later target then declines the first target
cases.native_observation: The same forward iterator visits first then late-target; incoming merges into late-target. List size 2; custom DynamicType calls 3.
cases.rust_observation: Matches native callback order, merge result, list size, and custom DynamicType call count.

cases.case: empty list skips incoming DynamicType query
cases.native_observation: SupportsMerge runs, the empty list short-circuits DynamicType lookup, then incoming appends. DynamicType calls 0.
cases.rust_observation: Matches the zero DynamicType calls and appends incoming.

cases.case: incoming DynamicType removes the original first target before cursor creation
cases.native_observation: DynamicType removes first; the newly created iterator visits only second. Incoming fails that merge and is appended. Events second; list size 2; DynamicType calls 2.
cases.rust_observation: Matches native order and result: no callback to the removed node, then incoming appends after second declines.

pre_fix_regression.method: Temporarily replaced only composite_alerts.rs with the pre-fix version, ran the regression file, then restored the fixed source.

defined_domain_note: Forward appends during SupportsMerge and Merge callbacks are tested. Removing the active NCollection_List iterator node from a callback is outside the defined native iterator domain and is not claimed.

dynamic_type_order_pre_fix.method: Temporarily replaced composite_alerts.rs with the main version before this fix, ran all four regression cases, then restored the fixed source.
